name: YOLO
unlock: Merge your own pull request without code review.
steps: Put a small feature on a branch and open a pull request in your own repo.
Run the project's checks, then merge the pull request without a formal review.
Check your GitHub profile and record whether the badge appears.
note: Automated checks and code review are different. Badge timing is not guaranteed.

name: Pair Extraordinaire
unlock: Have a pull request containing a co-authored commit merged.
steps: Work with a contributor and add a Co-authored-by trailer for their actual contribution.
Use their chosen GitHub-linked email, keeping a blank line before the trailer.
Merge the pull request with the trailer preserved and verify the profile separately.
note: Codex attribution alone is not proof that GitHub recognizes an eligible co-author.

name: Pull Shark
unlock: Have 2 pull requests merged. Higher tiers: 16, 128, and 1024.
steps: Propose a feature or useful documentation change through a pull request.
Have it merged; a closed but unmerged PR does not meet the recipe.
Continue with useful changes and check your profile for tier upgrades.
note: Commits and merged pull requests are different units. This pet counts local commits only.

name: Quickdraw
unlock: Close an issue or pull request within 5 minutes of opening it.
steps: Open a small maintenance issue in a repository you own.
Complete the task, then close the issue within 5 minutes of opening it.
Check your profile; record the outcome rather than assuming the badge was awarded.
note: Use your own farm for the experiment. One completed task is enough to try the recipe.
